title: CockroachDB keys, ranges and replication
brief: Trace CockroachDB SQL data through ordered keys, ranges and replicated ownership.
outcomes: Locate table and index data within ranges
Explain splits, leases, replica agreement and an unresolved hotspot
entry: General sharding, replication and index mechanics.

neighbours.RL126: Owns query work and hot ranges.

title: CockroachDB table locality and region survival
brief: Configure CockroachDB table locality and survival goals from actual access and failure requirements.
outcomes: Match regional-by-table, regional-by-row and GLOBAL tables to requests
Verify placement and survival without inventing regional timing evidence
entry: General regional placement, CockroachDB ranges and read contracts.

title: Operating and securing a CockroachDB cluster
brief: Operate a secure CockroachDB cluster with evidence about identity, range health and planned removal.
outcomes: Verify secure runtime identity, least privilege and tenant isolation
Diagnose under-replication and remove a node without losing the survival budget
entry: For security: general least privilege and trusted application/tenant ownership (RL104); the needed secure deployment and SQL object/session context is introduced locally. For node health/removal: also CockroachDB ranges (RL123), general rebalancing and the topology’s survival budget (RL109).

neighbours.RL123: Supplies range, lease and replica understanding before node health/removal work.
neighbours.RL109: Supplies movement and failure-headroom understanding before node health/removal work.

title: CockroachDB schema jobs under load
brief: Treat CockroachDB schema changes as observable jobs within an application compatibility protocol.
outcomes: Interpret job progress, failure and cleanup
Accept a backfill or unique index only after semantic checks
entry: General schema migration, constraints and CockroachDB architecture.

title: Upgrading a CockroachDB cluster
brief: Rehearse CockroachDB’s binary rollout and cluster-version boundary with explicit return limits.
outcomes: Distinguish mixed binaries from finalised compatibility
Verify rollback eligibility, application acceptance and recovery choices
entry: General cluster change, CockroachDB ranges, secure operations including the prepared node-health branch, and backups.
